main_issue: How to roster the days around National Day and Christmas so two staff are on duty each day, specifically whether Agent C must work both National Day days (C offered only one) in exchange for Christmas cover.

A-B.evidence: T7-10 A and B agree on the swap (A works day 1, B day 2); T22 A proposes B covers Christmas and B accepted (T21). But at T30 B sides with C ('He said he'd work one day, not two'), against A's plan (T27).

A-C.evidence: T18/T20 A wants to lock National Day first, C refuses (T19); T23/T28 C objects that the plan has him working both days, A insists no one else is available (T27).

A-D.evidence: T11-12 A gives D both days off and D says 'works perfectly'; T20 A rules D out of Christmas, consistent with D's stance; no later change.

B-C.evidence: T21 B takes Christmas, which C accepts (T23); T30 B backs C: 'He said he'd work one day, not two.'

B-D.evidence: Both accepted the swap plan (T10, T12) with D off both days; B later backs C's objection (T30), which would challenge D's arrangement, but they never address each other.

C-D.evidence: T14-16 C accepts D can't do Christmas but says the plan only suits the other three; D has both days off so C works both days, which C rejects (T28).
